title: Level-one majority weight error bounds
statement: For every integer $m\ge 0$, consider majority on the sign cube of dimension $2m+1$, taking the sign of the sum of the coordinates, with a zero sum assigned sign $+1$. Let $W_1$ be the sum of the squares of its level-one Fourier coefficients, meaning the coefficients indexed by singleton coordinate sets, and set $E_m=W_1-2/\pi$. Then $0\le E_m\le \dfrac{2}{\pi(2m+1)}$.
